column2: {title} provides comparisons of HMIS indicators using item-wise records. It supports monitoring and performance analysis of facility reporting through the financial year. Source is the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare (Department of Health and Family Welfare). Figures are provisional, and updates are irregular.

{title} presents monthly performance indicators for public facilities reporting attendance on the HMIS portal. The scope covers only districts that had shifted to facility-wise data uploading, excluding medical colleges. Data are presented at facility level rollups within ranges, capturing active facilities and their reporting and performance status.

{title} compiles the status and performance of key HMIS indicators across sub districts under the health management information system. It is intended for monitoring service delivery and comparing indicator trends across administrative units. The source is the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare (Department of Health and Family Welfare). Figures are provisional.

{title} provides monthly performance data for operation major (general and spinal anaesthesia) across public facilities. It focuses on districts that have shifted to facility-wise data uploading on the HMIS portal, excluding medical colleges. The dataset covers facility reporting and nil-performance handling for operational indicators, with data compiled at range-wise level based on facility activity during the reporting period.

{title} is a monthly facility-performance report for public facilities handling C-section deliveries, aggregated and presented range-wise. It helps monitor service delivery performance, reporting completeness, and facility-level functioning across eligible districts on the HMIS portal. Prepared under the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, focusing on district-level facility-wise uploads and excluding medical colleges. Data scope is facility-active and physically existing facilities.

{title} provides monthly performance data for public facilities performing Operation Minor (No or local anaesthesia), aggregated range-wise to support monitoring of service delivery. The report considers only districts that shifted to facility-wise uploading on the HMIS portal and excludes medical colleges. It covers facility-level active physical public facilities reporting to HMIS.

{title} presents monthly performance of public facilities conducting deliveries, aggregated and reported range-wise. The report is limited to districts that shifted to facility-wise data uploading on the HMIS portal and excludes medical colleges. It supports monitoring and review of delivery services by facility range, using HMIS operational facility reporting.

{title} provides performance indicators for Reproductive and Child Health (RCH), published by the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare. The dataset helps track progress across RCH services for program monitoring and planning. Figures are provisional and include free distribution-related indicator notes.

{title} tracks the performance of key HMIS indicators related to maternal health. It supports monitoring, program planning, and performance review of family welfare services. Source is the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, Department of Health and Family Welfare. Figures are provisional.

{title} compiles performance data on key HMIS indicators for child health under the Health Management Information System (HMIS). Data are updated with HMIS facility definitions and exclude medical colleges, for facility-wise reporting districts.

It supports program monitoring, baseline assessments, and public health research related to women’s health. Source is the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare (Department of Health and Family Welfare). Updates are irregular, aligned to survey cycles.

It supports health research, planning, and monitoring by giving a structured view of households and dwelling characteristics. Source is the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare (Department of Health and Family Welfare). It is published at annual periodicity and is irregularly updated on the OGD portal.

The dataset supports monitoring of family welfare service delivery and helps planners assess coverage performance and related need estimates for infants. It supports monitoring programme trends and identifying gaps where service delivery targets are not met. The data are from the HMIS portal under the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare. Figures are provisional, and NA indicates not available or not reported.

{title} provides indicator-wise performance data related to family planning sterilisation under RCH reporting. It includes estimates for unsterilised eligible couples and derived sterilisation rates, supporting monitoring of sterilisation performance and reproductive health outcomes. Source is the HMIS portal under the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare. Figures are provisional, with noted estimation formulae.
